caption:
Why does a cooked egg white never turn clear again? 🍳 Egg white is mostly protein, long chains folded into exact shapes. Heat shakes the folds apart, the loose chains stick to each other, and the old shape is gone for good.

In a protein, the shape is the job. More biology at pepsafe.info
